title: Why Tiffany Trump Is The Black Sheep Of Her Family
description:
She May Be Different From Her Family But She’s Following In The Trump Family Footsteps
Subscribe: http://bit.ly/Subscribe-to-Talko
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Everyone is familiar with Trump’s beloved eldest daughter, Ivanka, but have you heard of his youngest daughter, Tiffany? Considered a ‘black sheep’ of the family, Tiffany remains elusive to the media, but has been more involved with her family’s empire since Trump’s presidential campaign in 2016. 26-year-old Tiffany Trump is the only child from Donald’s second marriage, to Marla Maples, an affair which rocked the tabloids in 1992. In a campaign which centered around traditional values, it’s no wonder Tiffany was kept from the spotlight - as the product of an affair. While married to Ivana, Donald began an affair with Marla Maples, which Ivana cites as the cause of her divorcing Donald. Months after the divorce, Marla became pregnant, and the couple married soon after, shocking his family. The couple divorced when Tiffany was six, so Trump’s youngest daughter had little to do with her famous father, and has had a tumultuous relationship with her siblings. While Ivanka claims to “adore” her younger sister, she has also allegedly tried to push Tiffany out of any potential inheritance. This isn’t the only reason Tiffany is an outlier in comparison to her older siblings; Tiffany has taken action in support and against her father’s politics, and has been both praised and ignored by a father that originally didn’t want a child from his affair. Keep watching to learn more about Tiffany Trump, the black sheep of the Trump family.
